subject.title: Beta blocker: core build - 11 workspace packages ship without scripts.build

question: Should the next beta remain blocked until the workspace build graph is repaired and a clean source-install Gateway startup with bundled Feishu is proven?
rationale: The issue has a protected beta-blocker signal and reports a deterministic upgrade-time startup loop, so release ownership must decide whether to hold the beta or roll back the package migration.

options.title: Block and repair
options.body: Hold the next beta until all runtime workspace entrypoints build and clean-install plus upgrade Gateway startup proof passes.

options.title: Rollback migration
options.body: Restore the last known-good runtime package layout for the beta if a complete build-graph repair cannot be safely proven in time.

recommendation.title: Block and repair
recommendation.body: Hold the next beta until all runtime workspace entrypoints build and clean-install plus upgrade Gateway startup proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest available recent history around release validation and broad core/build maintenance.
